title: Deterministic space complexity class
statement: For a function $s:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{SPACE}(s)$ be the class of Boolean languages $L$ for which there exist a constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$ and a finite Turing machine that decides $L$ using at most $c\,s(n)$ space on inputs of length $n$.
